page.layout: One printed page: a running head with page number at the top; below it a full-width oval engraved portrait with its inscription around the oval; below the portrait a four-line Latin verse caption.

main_text.p: PHILIPPUS BARO DE MONTMORENCY, COMES DE HORN, etc.

Et me crudeles Albani hausere furores
Innocuum, Regique meo Patriæque fidelem:
Attamen (heu Albane ferox) me maxima vidi
Carnificis miserè dextra Bruxella cadentem.

page.notes: The portrait is an oval engraving of a bearded man in armour with a falling ruff, with its inscription running around the oval frame. The caption has a reference mark after "vidi" that looks like a small superscript figure; it is not copied. The engraved inscription is copied as printed, with its line of the verse set apart. Doubtful: "furores", "Patriæque" and "vidi" are read from a small scan and should be checked.
